body:
Feedback on 1.16.0: on the overview, an expense list shows its total and your
balance on both clients, but Android also shows a count (every expense counts as
an open item, since expenses are stored as todo and never ticked off) and the web
does not. Keep the count, on both — on the web counted explicitly as the number
of expenses — and give it some space from the total/balance on Android, where it
sat right against them.
title: overview: an expense list shows its expense count on both clients, with room before it on Android
